modules.module_title: Perform preventive and first line maintenance check

pcs.pc_description: collect the preventive maintenance checklist and maintenance log book for the MHE concerned
collect necessary tools and PPE necessary for conducting the preventive maintenance
understand the complaints noted in the log book, if any
observe the overall functioning of the MHE to identify problems if any
adjust in settings or operating parameters if required
check for damage in tyres, parking break, main horn, reverse horn, warning lamp, etc.
check fluid levels of engine, transmission, differential, hydraulic, radiator coolant and brake oil and top up any fluids as required
assess the MHE and escalate to supervisor if there is a likelihood of future problems or replacement is required.

identify any parts that have worn out or nearing their end of life cycle as specified by the manufacturer and put in request to obtain the required parts from the store (if available) or inform inventory clerk to place orders.
make replacement of part and test for its safety and smooth operation
in case of a machine overhaul, plan well in advance and perform it during holidays or non- peak hours.
test the MHE to ensure that it is fully functional and safe for use.
regularly maintain spare batteries and ensure they are fully charged
prepare and update maintenance card for every MHE
understand the type of breakdown reported/ witnessed during operation
identify and examine MHE to determine the source of the problem
determine if the problem could be resolved using existing skills or if it requires the attention of a specialized technician from the manufacturing company
if the problem could be resolved, determine whether the part could be repaired and carry out repairs using available spare parts/ machine shop equipment, or else put in part replacement request
receive required parts and change the parts as per manufacturer's guidelines.
complete and check all the line items in the first-line maintenance checklist
post first line repair, test the MHE to ensure that it is fully functional and safe for use
escalate to supervisor in case of delays or if a specialized technician from the manufacturing company is required to solve the problem
report to supervisor for replacement of MHE parts
provide daily report to manager regarding condition of equipment, damage if any, etc.
update MHE condition in the appropriate health card and the next review dates in the maintenance schedules
prepare a detailed report explaining the cause for the problem, solution, expected lifespan and suggested replacement dates
